integrity.computational_checks: bounded finite supporting tests, not a substitute for proof

scientific_limitations: Noiseless, complete, unindexed multiset of adjacent integer sums on the fixed alphabet {0,1,2}; no claims about noisy reads, larger alphabets, empirical biochemical experiments, or inverse-fiber size spectrum. Classical Euler theory used as a premise; earlier equivalent specialized work cannot be ruled out.
title: Exact linear and cyclic capacities of ternary adjacent-sum multispectra
